_note: The channels and feeds the daily watch reads. Measured on 2026-09-18 over https://t.me/s/<handle> and the feed URLs, from the VPS and from a laptop in the UAE; 109 handles were probed. A handle that does not exist answers HTTP 200 with a ~9.7 KB page and no message bubbles, so liveness here means a channel title plus at least one dated bubble, never a status code. Office channels are the signal; outlet channels and feeds are a net for the six offices in `uncovered` and are admitted only when they name one of them. No Telegram account, bot token or MTProto client is used to read any of this.
